name: 有効化・属性別方針・共有領域の指針を持つ自動仕分け設定
prompt:
Create one faithful Japanese-localized full settings panel for the automatic triage feature shown in the supplied source crop. Preserve the complete top-to-bottom structure and the compact 0.772:1 portrait composition of the 648 x 838 Japanese mock.

At the top, show the bold title 「自動仕分けの支援」 and one muted explanatory line: 「関連する課題や重複を探し、チーム、案件、分類、担当者を提案します。」. Do not add a docs link.

Below, show one thin-gray outlined rounded card. On its left place bold 「自動仕分けの支援を有効にする」 and beneath it the muted helper line 「関連する課題と属性の候補を表示します。」. Put an enabled green toggle at the far right.

Next, show the section heading 「提案の扱い」 with the supporting sentence 「表示、非表示、自動適用の方針を設定します。」. Under it place one rounded bordered list with six equal rows and light dividers. Use a pale-gray square icon tile, Japanese label and a white outlined dropdown labeled 「表示」 with a small view glyph and chevron in each row. The labels from top to bottom are: 「担当者の提案」, 「案件の提案」, 「分類の提案」, 「チームの提案」, 「重複する課題の提案」, 「関連する課題の提案」. Use distinct simple icons for people, project, tag, team, duplicate, and related issue.

Rows 1 through 4 also have a separate outlined filter-lines button to the right of the dropdown. Rows 5 and 6 have no filter button; preserve this exact difference. Do not add switches inside the rows or expanded menus.

At the bottom, show the heading 「共有領域の指針」, the muted line 「自動提案に必要な背景や追加の指示を、必要に応じて記入します。」, then one wide rounded multiline field with placeholder 「この共有領域で提案するときの指針…」. Preserve the spacing and field proportions from the mock.

Use the original source for the complete information hierarchy and the Japanese mock for exact localization, compact spacing, icon style and green enabled state. Meiryo typography: bold headings 20/28 where appropriate, regular body 14/24, and supporting text 12/16. The full panel should fill the 0.772:1 frame without large blank margins. No English text or extra controls.
reviewNotes: Visually reviewed at 1102x1427 (0.772:1), matching the 814x1055 source crop (0.772:1). The enabled state, all six localized proposal rules, first-four-only filter controls, and shared-guidance field are present in order. Fine typography and pixel-level spacing remain unverified.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
